description: Laboratory reports contain nitrate, nitrite, ammonium and phosphorus measurements from 21 Brampton stormwater ponds. ALS Waterloo performed the analyses. This resource is provided by Gab Izma. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists PDF formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The PDF laboratory reports require structured extraction before use in numerical models. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epa-swmm. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
name: Nutrient analysis in stormwater samples
